column1: # Actions: WARN (report, do not fail) | IGNORE (suppress) | FAIL
# Kept in the repo so every suppression carries a reason and can be reviewed,
# rather than being clicked away in a UI where nobody can see it later.
# Only suppress a rule when it does not apply to this architecture. If you are
# unsure, leave it as WARN and let the triage agent judge whether it is real.

column3: Missing Cache-Control on API responses. The API sets no-cache on the SSE stream; other endpoints return non-sensitive JSON.
Missing X-Content-Type-Options. Set by security_headers middleware in server/app.py; ZAP also flags it on 404s that never reach the middleware chain.
HSTS not set. TLS is terminated by the host's edge; the application container never sees HTTPS and cannot set this header meaningfully.
CSP header on API responses. The API returns only JSON and SSE, and does set a restrictive CSP; the page CSP lives in docs/index.html.
Permissions-Policy. Worth adding, but absent headers on a JSON API are low impact.
Timestamp disclosure. The health endpoint and job status intentionally report elapsed times.
Modern web application detection. Informational only.
Sec-Fetch headers. Informational; CORS is enforced server-side by an explicit origin allowlist.
